title: Delivery docket — Rossi Mill to Rosa Bakery
content:
ROSSI MILL — DELIVERY DOCKET
No. 4471        Date: 14/10

To: Rosa's Bakery
    12 Bridge St

Qty      Item                        Amt
40 x 25kg bags  Bread flour          ~~2,850.00~~
                                        3,000.00

Sub-total: ~~2,850.00~~ 3,000.00
Del. by: M.R.  Rec'd by: ____

(scribbled in margin: "chk w/ Rosa — 40 bags not 38")
(one line scratched out, initials "RM" over it)
messiness: crossed-out subtotal with corrected figure
abbreviations: qty, del., rec'd, chk, w/
margin note contradicts quantity
no due date or invoice number
handwritten, initials scratched over

title: Mensaje de voz — Carlos (Ortega Trucking) a Rossi Mill
content: Bueno, eh… habla Carlos, de Ortega Trucking. Oiga, le llamo por lo del flete del grano de octubre, ¿no? Este… ya le mandamos la factura hace rato y todavía no nos ha llegado el pago. Son dos mil cuatrocientos dólares, o sea, dos mil cuatrocientos por el transporte del grano de octubre. Eh… sé que andan con mucho trabajo, pero necesitamos que nos depositen esta semana, si se puede, porque ya tenemos que pagar el diésel y a los choferes. Bueno, deme una llamada cuando pueda y lo arreglamos, ¿le parece? Gracias, eh… que esté bien. Adiós.
messiness: spoken Spanish with filler words (bueno, eh, este, o sea, ¿no?)
amount stated twice in words, no written invoice number
no explicit due date, only 'esta semana'
informal, no letterhead or reference

title: WhatsApp — Main St Print Shop / Corner Cafe
content:
Main St Print Shop: Hey, your menu boards and loyalty cards are ready for pickup.
Corner Cafe: Nice. What's the total again?
Main St Print Shop: Give me a sec
Main St Print Shop: 600
Main St Print Shop: Sorry, wrong line. It's 650 total. The 600 was before we reprinted the boards.
Corner Cafe: Ok, 650 works.
Corner Cafe: Can we pay Friday?
Main St Print Shop: Friday's fine.
Corner Cafe: Perfect, thanks!
messiness: price first stated as 600, corrected to 650 in a later message
no invoice or reference number
no due date, only 'Friday'
casual shorthand, no currency stated

title: Email — Lee and Patel Accounting to Rossi Mill
content:
From: Marisol Lee <marisol@leeandpatel.example>
To: accounts@rossimill.example
Subject: Q3 bookkeeping + payroll — invoice attached

Hi team,

Hope Q4 is treating you well. Attaching our invoice for Q3. It covers the quarterly bookkeeping plus payroll runs for July, August and September.

Total due is USD 1,400.00. Same account as last quarter.

Let me know if you need the breakdown by month — happy to resend. We'd appreciate payment in the usual 30 days.

Thanks,
Marisol
Lee and Patel Accounting
messiness: amount buried in body text, not itemised
invoice is an attachment not shown in the body
no invoice number in the email text
due date only implied as 'usual 30 days'
